scenarios.title: Search for election-related prediction markets
scenarios.event: User asks to find markets related to 'presidential election'
scenarios.expectedAction: Query Gamma API with search term, return matching markets with prices and volumes

scenarios.title: Get top 10 trending markets by 24h volume
scenarios.event: User asks for the most active prediction markets right now
scenarios.expectedAction: Fetch markets, sort by volume24hr descending, return top 10 with key metrics

scenarios.title: Find 5-minute crypto markets for rapid trading
scenarios.event: User asks to discover active 5-minute BTC and ETH markets
scenarios.expectedAction: Search for short-resolution crypto markets, return token IDs for YES/NO outcomes

scenarios.title: List markets closing within 2 hours
scenarios.event: User asks what markets are about to resolve
scenarios.expectedAction: Fetch active markets, filter by end_date within 2 hours, sort by soonest

scenarios.title: No markets found for obscure search query
scenarios.event: User searches for a topic with no matching markets
scenarios.expectedAction: Return empty results with helpful message suggesting broader search terms

scenarios.title: Paginate through 200+ results
scenarios.event: User requests all active crypto markets (large result set)
scenarios.expectedAction: Paginate through multiple pages using offset, combine all results correctly

criteria: Search returns relevant markets matching text query: Does the skill correctly query the Gamma API and return matching markets?
Trending markets sorted by correct volume timeframe: Does the skill sort by the right volume field for the requested period?
Category filtering uses correct tag parameter: Does the skill filter markets using the Gamma API tag system?
Closing-soon accurately identifies markets within time window: Does the skill correctly parse end dates and filter?
5-minute market discovery finds short-resolution markets: Does the skill identify rapid-resolution crypto markets?
Output includes all IDs needed for downstream trading: Does the output contain tokenID, conditionID, and price data?
